about_the_game:
Build and expand your empire among the stars in this relaxing single-player RTS. Command fleets, manage planetary infrastructure, and research new technologies while enjoying a clear overview of your domain through minimalist visuals.

Key Features:

Strategic Resource Management

Manage your empire's infrastructure and resources across multiple planets. Each world offers limited building space and requires careful power management - insufficient electricity will slow down production and defensive capabilities.

Fleet Command

Build and command different spacecraft types, from civilian colony ships to military vessels. Combat follows an intuitive rock-paper-scissors system, where unit types counter each other but can overcome their weaknesses through technological advancement.

Three Distinct Species

Choose between the resourceful Hoomans, the adaptable Fungoreptis, or the rare mineral-dependent Octosects - each offering unique playstyles and challenges.

Research and Development

Construct research facilities to generate scientific knowledge and unlock new technologies. Upgrade your buildings, improve your units, and advance your civilization's capabilities.

Campaign and Skirmish Modes

Explore a non-linear campaign where each completed mission unlocks new challenges in neighboring star systems, from tutorial missions to complex scenarios.

Or dive into highly replayable skirmish matches on randomized maps featuring anything imaginable - navigate dense asteroid belts, harness the resources of multiple star systems, and adapt your strategy around black holes and space nebulae.

Gameplay Comfort

  • Adjustable game speed to match your preferred pace

  • Fair AI opponent that doesn't rely on cheating

  • Clear, minimalist interface providing complete oversight of your empire

  • Simple yet engaging combat system that minimizes micro-management

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: 5 Cores, 64 Bit Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A Dedicated GPU with Vulkan Support.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: You should have one.
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Try the Demo to see if it works.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Graphics Card (for example: GeForce RTX 3060)
